title: Three Kinds of Mentors
description: Volunteer, professional, peer -- three mentor types whose strengths do not overlap.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a recruiting scenario, the learner selects the mentor type whose strengths best fit the club's current need.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any type for what it brings and what it costs to recruit
pedagogical.assessment: Given a gap in the club, name which type fills it.
